pages.title: How it works
pages.content:
One invoice, four stages. You keep your customer, your contract and your pricing; we advance cash against a single invoice you choose.

1. Apply online

It takes about three minutes: your company number, your IBAN and a contact person. There is no setup fee, no monthly fee and no minimum volume.

2. Upload one invoice

Add the invoice with its delivery note or signed proof of delivery. We fund B2B invoices of €1,000–€150,000 issued to customers in the EU.

3. We confirm with your customer

Priya Raman’s underwriting team confirms the invoice with your customer by email within one working day. Your terms with the customer do not change.

4. Get paid

Once approved, 90% of the invoice value reaches your bank account the next working day. When your customer pays us, the remainder is released minus the single funding fee. Approved before 13:00 CET? Same-day payout is available for €25 per invoice.

A worked example

Invoice €12,400 on 30-day terms: €11,160 next working day, fee €173.60, and €1,066.40 paid when the customer pays.

Apply · 3 min

pages.title: Pricing
pages.content:
No setup, no monthly fee and no minimum volume. You see the fee before you accept the advance, and it is charged once per invoice.

Worked example

Invoice €12,400 on 30-day terms → €11,160 paid the next working day → fee €173.60 → €1,066.40 paid when your customer pays.

Fees are shown in euros in every language of this site. Approval depends on your customer’s credit and the delivery proof; nothing here is a promise of funding.

Apply · 3 min

pages.title: Who it's for
pages.content:
Azuke Finance is built for owners of small workshops and wholesale businesses who delivered on time and now wait thirty, forty-five or sixty days to be paid.

Who we fund

  • Makers and workshops with B2B customers, such as packaging, print and metalwork.
  • Wholesalers and food suppliers selling to shops, hotels and restaurants.
  • Service firms that invoice after each milestone.

What you need

  • A registered company in the EU and a business bank account.
  • B2B invoices of €1,000–€150,000 with a delivery note or signed proof.
  • A customer who pays by bank transfer on terms of up to 60 days.

Not for you if

you invoice consumers, or your customer has already disputed the invoice. In those cases we cannot buy the invoice, and we will say so within one working day.

Apply · 3 min

pages.title: Stories
pages.content:
Three suppliers and the invoices they funded. Names and figures are fictional examples.

Maren Holt, Holt Paper Goods, Antwerp

Maren runs a packaging and paper-goods workshop. She funded an €8,600 invoice on 45-day terms so she could buy cardboard reels without waiting for the customer.

Felipe Duarte, Duarte Bakehouse, Lyon

Felipe supplies bread to regional hotels. A €3,200 invoice on 30-day terms covered flour for a busy holiday run.

Sun-hee Park, Park Print Studio, Cologne

Sun-hee funded a €21,000 invoice on 60-day terms to pay two freelance printers on schedule.

pages.title: About
pages.content:
Azuke Finance B.V. was founded in Rotterdam in 2019 by Ines Vercauteren and Tomás Aldana. “Azuke” comes from the Japanese 預ける, to entrust something for safekeeping: you hand over one invoice and receive cash while the payment is pending.

Why we exist

Small suppliers often deliver on time and then wait thirty, forty-five or sixty days for payment. Bank facilities can demand security, and conventional factoring can mean multi-year contracts and monthly fees. We buy one invoice at a time, with one fee.

The team

  • Ines Vercauteren, Co-founder, Credit
  • Tomás Aldana, Co-founder, Operations
  • Priya Raman, Underwriting Lead
  • Jonas Weber, Supplier Relations
  • Amara Okoye, Customer Support

Office: Haringvliet 92, 3011 TG Rotterdam, Netherlands. Mon–Fri 8:30–17:30 CET.

Contact us

pages.title: FAQ
pages.content:
How fast is the money paid?

90% of the invoice value is paid the next working day after approval. Approved before 13:00 CET, same-day payout costs €25 per invoice.

What does it cost?

1.4% of the invoice for the first 30 days, then 0.7% for each further 15 days, capped at 4.2%. No setup, no monthly fee and no minimum volume.

Will my customer know?

Yes. We confirm the invoice with your customer by email within one working day, and your customer pays us when the invoice falls due.

Which invoices do you fund?

B2B invoices of €1,000–€150,000 to customers in the EU, with a delivery note or signed proof of delivery.

Is approval guaranteed?

No. We look at your customer’s credit and the delivery proof, and we tell you the answer within one working day.

Who do I talk to?

Amara Okoye and the Rotterdam help desk, Mon–Fri 8:30–17:30 CET, on +31 10 555 0192 or hello@azuke.example.

Apply · 3 min

pages.title: Apply

  2. Upload the invoice and its delivery note or signed proof.
  3. Review the fee we show you. Accept it, and we confirm the invoice with your customer within one working day.

To apply, email apply@azuke.example with your company number and the invoice attached, or call +31 10 555 0192 on weekdays between 8:30 and 17:30 CET.

pages.title: Privacy
pages.content:
How Azuke Finance B.V., Haringvliet 92, 3011 TG Rotterdam, handles the information you send us.

What we collect

The details you give when you apply: company name and number, contact person, bank account (IBAN), and the invoice and delivery documents you upload.

Why we use it

To assess the invoice, confirm it with your customer, pay you and meet our legal duties. We do not sell your data.

How long we keep it

For as long as needed to run your account and as required by law; then we delete it.

Your rights

You may ask to see, correct or delete your data. Write to hello@azuke.example and we will reply within one month.
